findings.headline: Gold is 59.5% of the export zone's shipments. A decade ago, coloured gemstones were about 46% of the city's exports.
findings.how: GJEPC's SEZ booklet, Table 7; GJEPC figures in GIA's 2016 study of Jaipur, Table 1 (cut stones only).

findings.headline: The Rajasthan region's exports jumped 82%. Gemstones explain about 0.3% of it.
findings.how: GJEPC's region tables. "About", not "at most": the gemstone figure is India's net change, not the region's. GJEPC reports this as the Rajasthan region, so I do too.

findings.headline: Studded gold jewellery exports +31%. Plain gold −8.8%.
During the 50% tariff, 60% of America's silver jewellery came from countries other than India, Thailand and China. A year earlier it was 29%.
findings.how: UN Comtrade, US imports by country, customs value.

findings.headline: India's share of America's gold jewellery fell from 26.3% to 4.4%. In March 2026 it turned.
findings.how: UN Comtrade, US imports by country. The US code for gold jewellery (HS 711319) also includes platinum jewellery.

findings.headline: Since 24 July 2026, Indian cut gemstones pay a 10% US duty. Before, they paid none.
findings.how: USTR's Section 301 final action and its exemption annex.

findings.headline: Every commercial-quality emerald auction from the Zambian mine since 2022 was viewed only in Jaipur: 9 of 9.
findings.how: Gemfields' auction announcements, 2009-2026. Viewed, not sold: bidding is online.

findings.headline: Commercial-quality emerald rough reached US$9.72 a carat, up 117% in two years.
findings.how: Gemfields' auction announcements. Gemfields warns that results aren't always directly comparable between auctions.

findings.headline: Rajasthan holds 11% of India's hallmarking licences for silver jewellers, with 5.9% of its people.
findings.how: A Rajya Sabha answer listing BIS licences by state (19 August 2025); population projections for 1 July 2025. The lead over Maharashtra is small and the count has grown since, so this is dated, not current.

findings.headline: This November-December has 11 wedding dates, against 17 last year. January-February has 22, against 12.
findings.how: Drik Panchang, set to Jaipur. Published lists differ on how many dates a season has, so I use one named source.

findings.headline: At Dhanteras 2025, ₹1 lakh bought 53% less gold than two Dhanterases before.
findings.how: IBJA's 999 rate, before GST and making charges. For 2025 it's the Friday close before a Saturday Dhanteras.

findings.headline: November brings about 6 times as many foreign visits to Rajasthan as June.
findings.how: Rajasthan Tourism's annual progress reports, monthly tables. These are visits, not tourists (one person seeing two cities counts twice), and state figures, not Jaipur's.
